title: Jev
description: Typed judgement over Babel records, as an independently optional part. It holds no store or panel and only reading and judgement-service authority. It reaches the baseline through doors: voters propose next actions for operator delivery, and cached current readings may prioritize the shared review draw through an authenticated ephemeral handoff. Missing or disabled readings retain baseline selection; funding is unknown. Jev cannot rule, change feed rank, withhold work or launch a session.

atyrode.babel.reason: every record it judges and every assessment it writes is read and written through babel's doors
